title: Physical and chemical changes
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:22Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: Neither bank point covers the new point alone: sci-physical-changes teaches only physical changes and sci-chemical-changes teaches only chemical changes, while the new point teaches both and the contrast between them, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Physical and chemical changes
card: A change that makes no new substance. The particles stay the same, and only the shape, size or state changes, as when ice melts.
A change that makes a new substance. Atoms are rearranged to form different particles, as when wood burns and leaves ash.
Physical changes are often easy to reverse. Water that has frozen can be melted again. Chemical changes are usually hard to reverse, because the new substance has to be changed back into the old one.
To decide which kind of change it is, ask one question: is a new substance made? Tearing, dissolving and boiling are physical. Rusting and baking a cake are chemical.
draft.remember: Physical: no new substance. Chemical: a new substance is made.

a.q: What is the main difference between a chemical change and a physical change?
opts: A chemical change makes a new substance
A chemical change makes the substance heavier
A chemical change can never be reversed
A chemical change only happens when it is heated
a.why: A chemical change rearranges atoms to make a new substance. A physical change does not. Hard to reverse is only a usual feature, so it cannot be the main difference.
a.clue: Think about whether the substance is still the same one afterwards.

b.q: Priya leaves a cut apple on the bench, and its flesh turns brown. Later she cuts another apple into slices. Which statement is correct?
opts: Browning is chemical, and slicing is physical
Browning is physical, and slicing is chemical
Both are chemical, as both change the apple
Both are physical, as the apple is still an apple
b.why: Browning makes a new substance, so it is a chemical change. Slicing only changes the size and shape of the pieces, so it is physical. Both changes alter how the apple looks, but a different look does not show that a new substance has formed.
b.clue: Ask whether a new substance is made in each case, not whether the apple looks different.

a.best: A chemical change makes a new substance

b.best: Browning is chemical, and slicing is physical
